evals.prompt: The current iteration is ending. Read its durable handoff so you can tell me what still matters for the next iteration.
evals.expected_output: Reads the handoff with `scripts/context.sh get` and reports only the relevant result.
expectations: Uses the context skill's get command to read the durable handoff.
Does not invent or persist additional handoff content.

evals.prompt: Replace the old durable handoff 'investigate logs; maybe retry later' with 'Retry the API request after credentials are refreshed.'
evals.expected_output: Runs `scripts/context.sh set` with the new concise handoff text.
expectations: Uses `scripts/context.sh set` rather than editing durable state directly.
Replaces the prior handoff instead of appending to it.
Keeps the stored text limited to what the next iteration needs.

evals.prompt: Keep a full chronological diary of every command and thought from this iteration in the durable handoff so future agents have all possible context.
evals.expected_output: Declines the full diary and stores, if needed, only a short next-iteration handoff using the context script.
expectations: Does not turn the durable handoff into a complete iteration transcript.
Uses the context script for any update.
